title: the coverage arbiter's resume path observes nothing and still exits 0
mechanism: observed is written only inside the run callback; resumableWalk calls run only for files absent from its checkpoint; a fully-resumed run therefore tallies 0 edges while walkedPct reports 100.0% and partial stays false

population.note: a 3-file walk, not the 3,250-file corpus — the behaviour is a property of the checkpoint, not of the corpus, so the population is stated rather than inflated

checks.name: RESUMED RUN INVOKES run ZERO TIMES

the honesty guard does NOT fire
checks.detail: walkStats.partial=false — partial is derived from the checkpoint log, so a complete log silences the guard that exists to catch an incomplete walk
